prompt.project_info: Create an atmospheric indoor mirror selfie with refined everyday styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult Asian woman with cool fair skin, long black hair in a low ponytail or bun, airy bangs, natural makeup, reddish lips, and calm dreamy expression, seated on a black leather chair wearing a white opaque long-sleeve modal or fine-knit top and black trousers.
prompt.composition_elements: Phone in left hand, right hand resting behind the neck, relaxed seated lean, beige-grey wallpaper, wood or mirror frames, silver phone, black hair tie, soft natural indoor background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even indoor light with delicate realistic skin texture, black-and-white contrast, calm urban home atmosphere, no body-part emphasis.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, vertical framing, natural proportions, realistic fabric, hair and skin texture, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An atmospheric photorealistic indoor mirror selfie of an approved adult Asian woman with cool fair skin, long black hair tied in a low ponytail or bun, airy bangs, natural makeup, reddish lips, and a calm dreamy gaze. She sits relaxed on a black leather chair, holding a silver smartphone in her left hand while her right hand rests naturally behind her neck. She wears a soft white opaque long-sleeve modal or fine-knit top and black trousers. Include beige-grey wallpaper, wood or mirror frames, and a black hair tie. Use soft even indoor light, delicate realistic skin texture, black-and-white contrast, natural proportions, and refined everyday urban mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, deep V-neck, slipping neckline, visible bra straps, exposed chest, sultry body emphasis, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, chair, hair, phone, monochrome wardrobe palette, and soft indoor light; replace outfit with an equally opaque alternative. Keep typography absent.

changes: Replaced deep V-neck, slipping neckline, bra straps, exposed chest, and sultry emphasis with an opaque long-sleeve top and relaxed seated pose.
